question.ambiguity_rule: An issuer statement that it is 'evaluating options' or 'exploring opportunities' in ordinary course is NOT a formal strategic-alternatives review; the announcement must present the review as a formal process. A merger or acquisition of the issuer is NOT a whole-book sale unless substantially all of the loan portfolio is separately sold. If an announcement is ambiguous between categories, it qualifies if it satisfies ANY single category on its own terms. Absence of qualifying news found by search is NOT a NO: a NO requires the enumerated per-issuer check below, because 'no cut found in a news search' and 'no cut occurred' are different claims.
annulment_rules: Annul only if the number of cohort members that remain publicly reporting falls below two before closes_at through delisting, merger or deregistration, so that the cohort-wide claim can no longer be evaluated as written.

Annul only if the filings and issuer records needed to establish each remaining member's regular dividend declarations across the interval are permanently unavailable after the registered negative-search procedure.
Do NOT annul because no qualifying announcement occurs; that is a NO.
question.claim: Between 2026-07-27 and 2026-12-31, at least one public CRE mortgage REIT in CREED's registered eleven-name cohort, other than ARI, KREF and RC, announces a dividend cut, a strategic-alternatives review, a wind-down, or a whole-book sale.
question.fallback_resolution_source: A dividend-history record from a data vendor that states the declaration date and the per-share amount, used ONLY to locate the candidate event, with the qualifying announcement then confirmed in the issuer's own filing or release before it counts.
question.negative_search_procedure: After closes_at, for EACH of the eight cohort members individually: retrieve the issuer's full EDGAR filing index for the interval and inspect every 8-K, plus the issuer's own dividend-declaration history, and record every regular common dividend declaration with its declaration date and per-share amount. Compare each declaration to its immediate predecessor. Separately scan each issuer's 8-Ks and releases for strategic-review, liquidation, dissolution, wind-down and portfolio-sale language. Record per issuer: filings inspected, declarations found with dates and amounts, disposition, source URL, access timestamp. Eight per-issuer records are required before any NO is proposed; a cohort-level news sweep is explicitly insufficient and has already produced a weak negative on this exact cohort on 2026-08-27.
question.resolution_condition: Resolves YES if, with an announcement date within opens_at inclusive to closes_at exclusive, any of BXMT, STWD, LADR, TRTX, GPMT, BRSP, ACRE or NREF announces at least one of: (a) a declared regular common dividend per share BELOW the immediately preceding declared regular common dividend per share; (b) a formal review of strategic alternatives; (c) a plan of liquidation, dissolution or wind-down; or (d) a sale of substantially all of its loan portfolio. Resolves NO if no such announcement occurs for any of the eight names within the interval.
question.resolution_rule: The cohort is FIXED at the eight names listed; ARI, KREF and RC are excluded because their actions are already inside the prediction's baseline and are not 'additional'. A cut is measured on the REGULAR common dividend per share versus the immediately preceding regular declaration; omitting or reducing a SPECIAL or supplemental dividend does not qualify, and neither does a preferred-dividend action. A dividend already reduced BEFORE opens_at is part of the baseline: BXMT's 2024 reduction from $0.62 to $0.47 does NOT qualify and must not be counted, and a search that surfaces that 2024 story is not evidence of a new cut. A share-count change that alters total payout without lowering the declared per-share rate does not qualify.
resolution_sources: SEC EDGAR filings for each cohort member (8-K Item 8.01 / Item 2.02, 10-Q, 10-K)
Each issuer's own dividend-declaration press release and investor-relations dividend history
